cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Lab Setting Card
cards.tableFit: Ages 8-10 cooperative family-table round where the group builds one calm tidepool lab scene.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, place one pencil in the center, and invite the table to offer tiny tidepool details aloud.
cards.kidDirection: Choose the timekeeper's job, collect three setting clues, and write the first small moment of the story.
cards.hostPrompt: Ask for one sight, one sound, and one texture, then let the writer choose which details belong on the page.

pageSections.heading: Lab Setting
lines: The tidepool lab is tucked beside ____________________.
The clearest sound in the lab is ____________________.
One texture the timekeeper touches is ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Timekeeper Choice
lines: The tiny tool on the table is ____________________.

cards.tableTalkLine: One tidepool detail our table agrees to use is ____________________.
cards.roundWrapLine: The round wraps up with the timekeeper choosing ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: If I want a quiet turn, I can circle the detail ____________________.
cards.takeHomeStoryLine: At home, the tidepool lab can open again when ____________________.

cards.title: Greenhouse Gear Garden Character Card
cards.tableFit: Ages 8-10 cooperative family-table card for choosing one garden helper and one shared speaking line.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, set out pencils, and ask the table to name gentle greenhouse jobs before writing starts.
cards.kidDirection: Pick a gear-garden helper, give the helper a clear choice, and write one line of dialogue.
cards.hostPrompt: Invite short suggestions for what the helper sees, wants, and says in a friendly greenhouse moment.

pageSections.heading: Garden Helper
lines: One gear in the garden moves near ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Speaking Line
lines: Another table idea for dialogue is ____________________.
The line shows the helper feels ____________________.

cards.tableTalkLine: One greenhouse job we can picture together is ____________________.
cards.roundWrapLine: The round wraps up after the helper decides to ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: If I want a quiet turn, I can write the helper's object as ____________________.
cards.takeHomeStoryLine: At home, the gear garden grows a new scene around ____________________.

cards.title: Pantry Measurement Mystery Sequence Card
cards.tableFit: Ages 8-10 cooperative family-table card for ordering three pantry clues into one short scene.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and invite the table to choose three harmless pantry objects as pretend story clues.
cards.kidDirection: Order the pantry clues, add one exact measurement detail, and draft the next step in the scene.
cards.hostPrompt: Ask what should happen first, what changes next, and which small measurement detail makes the scene clearer.

pageSections.heading: Pantry Clues
lines: The first pantry clue sits beside ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Clear Order
lines: After that, the helper moves toward ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Next Step Draft
lines: The exact amount I will include is ____________________.

cards.tableTalkLine: One pantry clue our table can place in order is ____________________.
cards.roundWrapLine: The round wraps up when the pantry helper reaches ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: If I want a quiet turn, I can number the clue ____________________.
cards.takeHomeStoryLine: At home, the pantry scene can continue with ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Sensory Route Card
cards.cardSkill: Sensory detail, sequence, and ending choice
cards.tableFit: Ages 8-10 cooperative family-table round where the group builds one weather route together.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, invite one gentle weather detail from the table, and keep the route short.
cards.kidDirection: Choose the railway route, add two sensory details, and decide where the ending should stop.
cards.hostPrompt: Ask what the gauge shows, what the railway feels like, and which stop gives the story a satisfying ending.

pageSections.heading: Gauge Reading
lines: The air around the platform smells like ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Route Sequence
lines: Before the last stop, the rider notices ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Ending Choice
lines: One final detail to add is ____________________.

cards.tableTalkLine: One railway sound our table can use is ____________________.
cards.tinyDraftLine: My route sentence includes the detail ____________________.
cards.roundWrapLine: The round wraps up at the railway stop called ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: If I want a quiet turn, I can choose the ending place ____________________.
cards.takeHomeStoryLine: At home, the rain gauge route can continue toward ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Library Map Room Revision Card
cards.cardSkill: Map detail, revision, and ending choice
cards.tableFit: Ages 8-10 cooperative family-table card for revising one map scene with clearer details.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, ask the table for one map-room object, and remind writers they can improve one sentence.
cards.kidDirection: Pick a seed map, write a short route, revise one vague word, and choose the ending doorway.
cards.hostPrompt: Ask which noun should be more exact, which route detail should move earlier, and where the story should end.

pageSections.heading: Map Room Detail
lines: The seed map is spread across ____________________.
The clearest label on the map says ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Revision Spot
lines: A vague word I can replace is ____________________.
A stronger noun for the sentence is ____________________.
The revised detail helps readers picture ____________________.

pageSections.heading: Ending Doorway
lines: The ending line should leave the reader with ____________________.

cards.tableTalkLine: One map-room detail our table wants to keep is ____________________.
cards.tinyDraftLine: My revised sentence will change ____________________ to ____________________.
cards.roundWrapLine: The round wraps up when the seed map points to ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: If I want a quiet turn, I can underline the word ____________________.
cards.takeHomeStoryLine: At home, the seed library story can end near ____________________.
